finding: Groq Free-like RPD/TPM response headers are not sufficient economic provenance for FREE_ONLY execution. Groq documents organization-specific rate-limit exceptions and permits projects to set custom limits at or below organization ceilings, so a paid Developer-tier project can present limits equal to documented Free-plan limits. The previous exact-header match could therefore self-consistently authorize a paid-capable credential.
counterhypothesis: Matching documented Free-plan x-ratelimit headers uniquely identifies a Groq Free-tier credential.
delta: Groq rate-header matches are retained only as corroborating telemetry, never billing authority.
Groq autonomous FREE_ONLY admission now requires fresh provider-side Free-tier evidence bound to the exact credential fingerprint and exact allowed model set.
The entitlement binding requires tier=FREE, evidence_ref, observed_at, valid_until, a bounded maximum entitlement age, and exact allowed_models.
Current canonical credential_entitlements remains empty, so Groq fails closed until real provider-side Free-tier evidence is bound; no credential is guessed or post-hoc relabeled.
OpenRouter, NVIDIA and Mistral semantics are intentionally not reimplemented in this delta; NVIDIA and pre-call binding have active overlapping PRs #1467 and #1468.
test_cases: Free-like rate headers alone fail closed.
Exact fresh provider-side Free-tier binding admits the exact credential/model.
Developer-tier binding remains rejected even with Free-like headers.
Credential entitlement cannot expand to an unbound model.
